title: Two years packaging the thruster into grounded enclosures
summary: Charles Buer tells of Two years packaging the thruster into grounded enclosures, about 2016-2018 at Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, after Drew and I did these experiments in 2016, uh I think we spent about two years trying to package it.

plain: Charles Buer, whom a podcast title calls a NASA chief, says that after he and a colleague named Andrew Arjima ran experiments in Florida in 2016 on a thruster, a device meant to push something along, they spent about two years fitting it into electrically grounded boxes. He tells it as part of a longer effort to show the device produces real thrust, which would matter because the episode presents it as a step toward antigravity propulsion.
